title: 第十九章血色任务牌第二十章我也要接
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 蹲在地上盯着泥地里乱七八糟的圆圈，叶凡脑子转的飞快。
废丹这条路呢，确实快到头了。
十天来一批新货，每批能挑出几百颗用的。
听着不少，可九龙搬血那张嘴越撑越大，几百颗废丹扔进去连个响都听不见啊。
揉了揉太阳穴，把那些越算越吓人的数字全赶出脑袋。
眼下最紧迫的可不是资源枯竭，是外门那群闻着味来的疯狗。
站起身在屋里来回踱步。
脚踢到一块碎木板翻了个个儿，露出底下压着的一块灰布。
那是刚进外门时领的青色劲装，洗的发白，袖口还有药渣烧出的破洞。
把衣服往肩上一搭，手无意识的往怀里摸了摸。
指尖碰到一块冰凉的铁片。
叶凡愣了一下，把那东西掏出来。
巴掌大的铜牌，正面刻着天剑宗外门四个小字，背面是名字和编号。
这是外门弟子令牌。
拿着令牌翻来覆去看了两遍，叶凡猛的一拍大腿，整个人都蒙圈了。
“我操！真是个棒槌！”
差点把这茬给忘了啊。
自己名义上，可是正儿八经的外门弟子。
不是杂役，不是下人，是交了入门费上了册领了牌的外门弟子！
马得水把他发配到废阁那是管事分配差事。可宗门的规矩摆在那里，外门弟子的权利一样也没少他的。
外门任务大厅对他开放。
经阁基础层对他开放。
月俸灵石该给还得给。
其实一个月几块破灵石能干嘛呢？塞牙缝都不够吧。不对，穷的叮当响的时候哪怕是分币不挣的事也不能少，苍蝇腿它也是肉啊。
捏着令牌，思路越来越清晰。
任务大厅。
天剑宗的任务大厅每天都会更新各种差事。清剿妖兽，采集灵草，护送商队，打探消息。
从锻体境到筑基期，各阶各层都有对应的任务。
完成任务能拿灵石呢。
更重要的是，有些任务需要下山。
需要去凡俗世界。
叶凡在心里迅速盘算。
去接那种需要前往凡俗世界的任务。
一边拿宗门的报酬去办事，顺手还能在凡俗界收购一波破烂法器。
回来之后往合成炉里一丢，废铁变宝贝。
一举两得。
越想越觉得这条路走的通，正要动身，脚步却在门槛前顿住。
不对。
content_en:
Squatting on the ground and staring at the messy circles in the mud, Ye Fan's mind was spinning rapidly.
The road to waste pills is indeed coming to an end.
A new batch of goods comes in ten days, and you can pick out a few hundred pills from each batch.
It sounds like a lot, but Jiulong's mouth is getting bigger and bigger, and hundreds of useless pills are thrown in without even making a sound.
He rubbed his temples and drove all the increasingly scary numbers out of his head.
The most urgent thing at the moment is not the depletion of resources, but the group of mad dogs coming from the outer gate.
He stood up and paced back and forth in the room.
He kicked a piece of broken wood and turned it over, revealing a piece of gray cloth underneath.
It was the green outfit he had worn when he first entered the outer gate. It had turned white after washing, and there were holes in the cuffs that had been burned by the medicine residue.
He put his clothes on his shoulders and unconsciously touched his arms.
His fingertips touched a piece of cold iron.
Ye Fan was stunned for a moment and took out the thing.
A palm-sized bronze medal with the four small characters Tianjian Sect Outer Gate engraved on the front, and the name and number on the back.
This is the outer disciple token.
After flipping the token over and over again, Ye Fan slapped his thigh hard and his whole body was confused.
"Holy shit! What a stick!"
I almost forgot about this.
In name, he is a serious outer disciple.
Not a handyman, not a servant, but an outer disciple who paid the entry fee, registered and received his license!
Ma Deshui assigned him to Feige, where he was assigned errands by the steward. But the rules of the sect are there, and the rights of the outer sect disciples are not lacking in his.
The outer mission hall is open to him.
The basic level of Jing Pavilion is open to him.
The monthly salary and spiritual stone must be given.
In fact, what can you do with a few broken spirit stones a month? It's not even enough to fill the gap between your teeth. No, when you are poor, you have to do things even if you don't earn pennies. A fly's legs are still meat.
Holding the token, my thoughts became clearer and clearer.
Mission hall.
The mission hall of Tianjian Sect will update various errands every day. Suppress monsters, collect spiritual herbs, escort caravans, and find out information.
From the body forging stage to the foundation building stage, each level has corresponding tasks.
You can get spiritual stones by completing the mission.
What's more, some missions require going down a mountain.
Need to go to the mortal world.
Ye Fan quickly calculated in his mind.
To take on missions that require traveling to the mortal world.
While doing things with the sect's reward, he can also buy a wave of broken magic weapons in the mortal world.
When you come back, throw it into the synthesis furnace, and the scrap metal will turn into treasure.
Kill two birds with one stone.
The more I thought about it, the more I felt that this path was feasible. Just as I was about to set off, my steps stopped in front of the threshold.
wrong.
